descriptionByLocale.it:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way. The role and team: Logitech is looking for an experienced Software Project Manager to join our Software Organization. If you are passionate about revolutionizing the personal workspace and building tools that enhance daily productivity, this is the place for you. You will be the driving force behind the software that powers Logitech’s world-class desktop and mobile applications, ensuring an exceptional, seamless experience for millions of users worldwide. Working in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment, you will bridge the gap between strategy and execution. You will also help drive the evolution of software development by leveraging AI to reshape the way we work. By partnering closely with Engineering, QA, Embedded Software, Product Management, and Design, you will help shape the future of how people work, create, and connect. Your Contribution: Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will: Project Execution & Delivery
• Own and manage project schedules, deliverables, and the end-to-end software product life cycle.
• Actively identify project risks and develop creative mitigation and contingency plans to keep projects on track.
• Champion processes and tools that standardize software development, continuously identifying inefficiencies and implementing smart improvements. ​ Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategy
• Partner closely with Product Owners to manage backlogs, prioritize requests, and deliver best-in-class software experiences that elevate our hardware.
• Build strong, trusting relationships with key stakeholders across Design, Product Marketing, Engineering, and QA.
• Provide clear, regular communication and status reports to stakeholders and Business Group leaders, thoughtfully escalating risks during management and Gate reviews. Agile Leadership & Scrum Mastery
• Act as the Scrum Master for multiple teams, championing the Scrum framework and guiding teams in agile best practices.
• Drive and coordinate essential agile ceremonies, including backlog grooming, sprint planning, demos, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups.
• Proactively resolve issues and remove obstacles so your teams can focus on delivering high-quality work. Key Qualifications: For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and experiences to our team:
• Experience: 5+ years of Software Project Management experience in the consumer electronics or tech industry, with demonstrated expertise in project management methodologies.
• Agile Expertise: Certified Scrum Master (CSM) with at least 1 year of active, hands-on Scrum practice and a deep understanding of Scrum principles.
• Technical Acumen: A solid grasp of the intersection between hardware, embedded software (firmware), and application software.
• AI Integration: Demonstrated understanding of AI and how it can benefit software development, transform day-to-day workflows, and drive increases in both efficiency and quality.
• User-Centric Mindset: Deep empathy for user needs, a passion for productivity tools, and a relentless commitment to software quality.
• Execution: Exceptional organizational, planning, and self-management skills.
• Communication: Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact, influence, negotiate, and collaborate effectively across global geographies and all levels of management. ​ Preferred Qualifications:
• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
• Experience working closely with firmware and hardware products. Education:
• A BS/MS in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
• Prior experience working as a so

title: Senior Hardware Product User Experience Designer

titleByLocale.it: Progettista senior dell'esperienza utente del prodotto hardware
titleByLocale.en: Senior Hardware Product User Experience Designer
titleByLocale.de: Senior Hardware Product User Experience Designer
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Hardware Product User Experience Designer

descriptionByLocale.it:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way. The Role Senior Hardware Product User Experience Designer Level: I3 Location: Lausanne, Switzerland Working model: Hybrid (2–3 days/week in the office) We’re looking for a Senior Hardware Product User Experience Designer who thrives in complexity, precision and enjoys turning technical systems into simple, elegant user experiences. You’ll be part of Logitech’s Global User Experience team, supporting both the Gaming and Personal Workspace categories — two of the company’s most dynamic and fast-evolving business groups. This is a unique hybrid role combining:
• Hardware Product User Experience design on platform topics such as connectivity and product behavior. You will create guidelines to harmonize experiences across products.
• Keyboard layout design , requiring high attention to detail, precision, and strong visual craft. You are a systems thinker with strong product instincts, equally comfortable designing high-level architecture and crafting pixel-perfect layouts. You care deeply about how things work—not just how they look—and you’re motivated by solving real user problems across hardware and software. Responsibilities Product & Platform Experience
• Design end-to-end product experiences across hardware interactions with firmware and software in mind
• Contribute to platform-level UX topics (e.g., connectivity, device behaviors, system interactions)
• Translate complex technical constraints into clear, intuitive user experiences
• Define information architecture and interaction models for complex systems Keyboard Layout Design
• Own and design complex keyboard layouts across multiple products, operating systems, and regions
• Create precise, production-ready layout files with strong attention to detail
• Ensure consistency across languages, markets, and product lines
• Collaborate closely with hardware, engineering, and localization teams to align on constraints
• Maintain and evolve standards, guidelines, and assets for keyboard layouts Logitech Design System Contribution
• Contribute to the evolution of the Logitech Design System
• Define and document platform (e.g., Bluetooth Connectivity) and product guidelines (e.g., Webcam guidelines)
• Ensure alignment between design and engineering implementation (design ↔ firmware engineering)
• Identify opportunities to standardize and scale solutions across products and platforms
• Actively contribute to consistency across Logitech product experiences
• Collaborate with design system and platform teams to improve reusability and quality Key Qualifications For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and experiences to our team: Design & Systems Thinking
• Strong experience designing complex consumer hardware products
• Strong portfolio showcasing hardware design solutions (e.g., consumer electronics, mobile, ergonomic products, etc.)
• Ability to translate product work into reusable guidelines
• Deep understanding of user-centered design principles and methodologies Craft & Execution
• Strong visual and interaction design skills with a high bar for quality and detail
• Excellent understanding of typography, layout and visual hierarchy
• Exceptional attention to detail and ability to deliver production-ready assets
• Understanding of localization challenge, typography, and spatial constraints Tools & Technical
• Advanced proficiency in Adobe Illustrator
• Experience with Figma
• 3D application is a plus Collaboration & Communication
• Experience working closely with engineering and product teams
• Strong storytelling and presentation skills
• Strong in communication with multiple stakeholders and teams
• Comfortable navigating ambiguity and fast-paced environments Life at Logitech Logitech is the sweet spot for people passionate about products, making a mark, and having
